inspection.title: Crane Daily/Weekly Inspections & Maintenance
inspection.legend: Tick where satisfactory, X where a defect has been identified, N/A if not applicable. Any issues with the crane are to be phoned through to the Bennetts office on 01453 811754. The crane should not be reset until instructed by Bennetts.
inspection.supervisorNote: Items marked * are to be completed by the Banksman / Crane Supervisor.

sections.title: Daily Pre-Use Checks
items: Condition of mains cable & earthing
Base Bolts / Pins & clear of Obstruction / Debris
Condition / Security of Tower Bolts
Condition of Ladders / Platforms / Tower
Check Counter Jib Fittings
Check Counter Jib Ballast Security
Check RAM Condition / Operation / not creeping
Check motors free of unexpected noise / vibration
Check Hoist Rope Condition & Lubrication
Check Trolley / Luffing Rope Condition & Lubrication
Check Slew Teeth, Bolts Condition & Lubrication
Check Hoist / Luff Limit Paddle
Cleanliness of Crane and Decking
*Security of Loose Items e.g. Lifting Accessories
*Check Hook Block Safety Catches and Swivel
Check Visual Display (if fitted)
Cab Gauges and Warning Lights
Check Hook Block Height Limit
Operation of Slewing Brakes
Operation of Emergency Electrical Isolation
Operation of Hoist / Trolley / Luffing Brakes
Check all Controls respond correctly including joysticks, horn, buttons
Check Dead Man Control (if fitted)
Check Trolley / Luffing In / Out Limiter
Windspeed Indicator
Confirm Zoning System Shunt Plug is NOT in use
Confirm Zoning system stops at correct points
Visual Inspection of Jib Pivot Pins, Locking Pins & Keeper Plates (Luffing)
Jib Radius correct & Slew Brake lifted for Free Slew, Green light Operational
Condition of doors and glazing, including the handles, cab door latch, cab door lock & the locking mechanism
All ancillaries checked, secure & operational
Condition of Collar & Tie – Pins, Collar Bolts, Wedges, Base Plate Bolts

sections.title: Daily Closedown Procedures
items: Remove all lifting tackle from hook block
Raise hook block to visible height from cab
Set Luffing / Trolley Out of Service Radius
Put Crane in Free Slew
*Check Aircraft Warning Lights
Press Emergency Stop in cab
Secure Drivers Cab, Windows, anti climb hatch & all openings, including hoarding door
Report Defects

inspection.declaration: All certification relevant to this crane, equipment and accessories are held by the Client / Hiring Organisation. I have carried out all prescribed maintenance and I am satisfied that all safety devices operate in a satisfactory manner, as disclosed above. I am in receipt of a Bennetts induction for the operation of this crane. A rescue system is in place, rescue from height training has been rolled out and the appropriate equipment is available.

timesheet.title: Drivers Time Sheet
timesheet.deadline: All timesheets must be signed & returned to us by no later than 4pm every Monday.
notes: Contracts are based on a minimum of 10 hours per day (Monday – Friday) for both crane and driver i.e. if you work less than 10 hours you will still be charged for 10 hours.
"The signature of the Hirer's representative shall bind the Hirer to accept the hours shown on the Drivers Time Sheet." CPA Terms and Conditions – Clause 18(a)
Allowance will only be made for breakdowns which are detailed on this timesheet.
